342715.title: Radio-Activity
342715.alt: A stark black-and-white, high-contrast illustration of a vintage radio speaker — a large circular mesh grille flanked by two round control knobs and a rectangular label plate, framed by thin white border lines.

693786.title: Hills Of Katmandu
693786.alt: A cosmic starfield with a glowing grid-mapped galaxy sphere and a rising sun arcs above a futuristic silver spire, flanked by ornate, fanged Himalayan-style demon masks in orange, pink and gold, set against a deep black and blue night sky.

746295.title: Spin Spin Sugar
746295.alt: A purely typographic black-and-white vinyl record label, with a white circular center bearing bold grey and black text, two small logos at the top, and a black spindle hole in the middle against a black background.

1315086.title: Hemispheres
1315086.alt: A picture-disc vinyl record showing a surreal painted scene against a blue sky: a nude figure stands with arm outstretched atop a vast red-pink brain-like landscape, while a bowler-hatted man in a dark suit with a cane stands on the horizon at left, with red script lettering at the top.

1340405.title: Queen Of Soul
1340405.alt: A close-cropped portrait of a woman's face lit in warm amber and orange tones against a black background, framed by concentric thin-line rectangles on a dark cover.

2505382.title: Faith
2505382.alt: A heavily blurred, sepia-toned photograph of a distant ruined stone archway or abbey window rising above faint grasses in the lower right, rendered in hazy grey-brown monochrome.

3375961.title: Dookie
3375961.alt: A busy hand-drawn cartoon illustration in colored pencil and ink shows a fighter jet dropping bombs labeled "dookie" over a chaotic, densely packed cityscape crowd, with a blimp, monkeys, and clouds framing large blocky lettering above and bubbly red lettering below.

3961216.title: A Charlie Brown Christmas
3961216.alt: Three cartoon children hold hands dancing around a decorated green Christmas tree topped by a white beagle standing on its peak, with a yellow star ornament and colorful baubles, all set against a plain white background beneath green and red text.

4899952.title: School Daze
4899952.alt: High-contrast black-and-white image of a mustachioed man's face staring intently at the viewer, his features reduced to stark white shapes emerging from a solid black background flecked with small white specks.

5455999.title: American IV: The Man Comes Around
5455999.alt: High-contrast black-and-white photo of an older man's face in profile wearing glasses, head bowed and emerging from deep shadow in the lower right, beneath large bold white capital letters across the top of a black background.

5466884.title: At Last!
5466884.alt: A woman shown in profile with a blonde bouffant hairstyle and a long rhinestone drop earring appears at the lower right of a bright yellow background, with red and green lettering across the top and a gold sticker at the left, all beneath a shrink-wrap sheen.

6089455.title: You're Dead!
6089455.alt: A surreal psychedelic collage of a man's face with a blazing white void where his eyes and nose should be, hands raised beside him and exposed veins across his neck, set against an explosive orange starburst dotted with circular motifs and small floating figures, framed by a yellow patterned border.

6340377.title: The Transformers®: The Movie (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)
6340377.alt: A pale-lavender vinyl sleeve featuring 1980s cartoon-style robot warriors firing orange laser blasts upward around a central blue-and-red leader figure, with chrome red-and-blue block lettering and a red robot-face emblem across the top and track listings in red text down both sides.

6709270.title: Let My Children Hear Music
6709270.alt: A dark, abstract painting in deep reds and browns featuring a rainbow arc, glowing orange spheres and orbs, a small stylized tree, and thin geometric lines suggesting a surreal cosmic landscape.

7175735.title: Moon Safari
7175735.alt: A loose watercolor and ink illustration of two young men striding forward — one in an orange shirt, the other in yellow overalls — against a patchwork of blue, teal and orange brushed squares, with a bold outlined logo block in the upper left corner.

7492163.title: Muscle Up
7492163.alt: A grayscale, high-contrast halftone collage inside a large circle showing a starry cosmic sky with planets and a comet above a city skyline set on a receding grid landscape, with a reclining classical statue's head at the lower left, framed by bracket-like lines on a gray background.

7954216.title: ★ (Blackstar)
7954216.alt: A large five-pointed star cut out of a translucent, faintly iridescent vinyl record — its circular label and center hole visible at the middle — set against a flat grey background.

8019872.title: Deltron 3030
8019872.alt: A sepia and olive-toned photographic image of silhouetted figures walking single file up a steep angled ramp or bridge toward a massive curved dome-like structure, with bold text and interlocking circle logo across the top.

8607137.title: Begin To Hope
8607137.alt: A high-contrast black-and-white photo of a curly-haired woman gazing over her shoulder against a white background, scattered with small orange stars and a tiny red heart dangling from a thin drawn line.

9100480.title: Bury Me At Make Out Creek
9100480.alt: A photograph of a grid-like glass office building facade in muted grey and brown tones, with one small window ajar, mounted on an off-white background and overlaid with a cut-out white paper strip bearing black serif text.

10243455.title: Cosmogramma
10243455.alt: A black-and-white pen-and-ink drawing of a large pale circle radiating dense hand-drawn rays like a sun, with a scattering of small dark dots and speckled spheres trailing off to the lower left across a textured off-white background.

10505746.title: Greatest Hits
10505746.alt: A person with wild dark curly hair holds both hands outstretched toward the camera against a deep blue background scattered with hanging silver stars, with yellow and white text overlaid across the palms.

10816722.title: Lost Highway
10816722.alt: A dark, blurred nighttime photograph of a road stretching into blackness, with a glowing yellow-orange streak of light down the center and streaked headlight trails at the sides, overlaid with bold yellow block lettering at the top and a white sticker in the upper right corner.

11168277.title: In Concert
11168277.alt: A green-bordered LP sleeve featuring a grainy stage photograph of a woman in a long pale patterned gown standing beside instruments in dim light, with a track list in cream type to the right.

11334128.title: P5: Persona 5 Soundtrack
11334128.alt: A framed square print with a bold red starburst at its center bearing a large white "P5" logo, surrounded by shattered panels showing grayscale anime characters in masks and stylish outfits against patterned backgrounds.

11585678.title: Post
11585678.alt: A dark-haired woman in a white airmail-striped kimono-style jacket gazes at the camera in front of a glossy pink-red circular disc, set against a colorful collage backdrop of magenta, orange and purple patterns.

11604962.title: Steven Universe, Vol. 1 (Original Soundtrack)
11604962.alt: A flat, geometric illustration in muted pinks, teals and greys of a large open hand cradling a sparkling faceted gem, a washing machine, a small house and a clothesline strung with tiny shirts, set against a stylized mountain landscape.

12186161.title: The Now Now
12186161.alt: A stylized comic-book illustration on a pale blue background shows a spiky-haired figure in a leather jacket and boots leaning back mid-solo with an electric guitar, rendered in bold black linework with hot pink offset shadows.

12682791.title: Everybody Else Is Doing It, So Why Can't We?
12682791.alt: Four young people in dark clothing sit clustered on and around an armchair against a black background, dramatically lit in warm, moody tones, with one seated barefoot on the floor in front.

13199486.title: Rumours
13199486.alt: A black-and-white photograph on a plain light background shows a bearded man in a vest, puffy shirt and tights standing with one leg raised on a small ornate stool, beside a blonde woman in a flowing black shawl and dress, with stylized script text across the top.

13772039.title: Music Sounds Better With You
13772039.alt: A purely typographic cover: bold gold lettering centered on a dark navy-black background, framed by a decorative border of small gold stars.

13924520.title: The Velvet Rope
13924520.alt: A woman with voluminous curly copper-toned hair tilts her head downward with eyes closed, her face partly veiled by ringlets, set against a deep crimson background and wearing a dark top.

14111369.title: Snacks
14111369.alt: A smiling man in a pink cap, white shirt and black backpack leaps mid-air holding a red shopping basket, in front of brightly stocked supermarket shelves of colorful bottles, boxes and packages, with bold white 3D lettering and red script arching across the top.

15924347.title: The Social Network
15924347.alt: A heavily blurred, digitally glitched close-up portrait of a face fills the frame, streaked with vertical smears of vivid blue, red, and teal against muted grey-brown tones, with white sans-serif text overlaid across the upper third.

15933665.title: No Need To Argue
15933665.alt: Four band members in dark suits pose on and around a worn brown velvet sofa in a stark white room with pale wooden floorboards, with handwritten-style text in the upper right corner.

16029294.title: Computer World
16029294.alt: A vintage grey computer terminal with keyboard sits against a bright yellow background, its screen displaying four stylized yellow-and-black profile portraits of men in a row, framed by dotted-matrix lettering above and below.

16093356.title: Song Machine Season One
16093356.alt: A vivid pink and teal collage of stacked music gear — keyboards, synths, a keytar, and a gramophone horn — cluttered with surreal objects like a horned masked face, floating planets, a poison bottle, a goblet, and a red hand emerging from a keyboard, set against a spiral record-like disc backdrop.

16205708.title: Street Fighter III: The Collection
16205708.alt: A vibrant manga-style illustration on an off-white square sleeve, showing a dynamic collage of Street Fighter characters — Ryu firing a glowing hadouken in the foreground, with Ken, Chun-Li, Alex, Dhalsim and others radiating outward in bold reds, blues and oranges.

16206941.title: Pastel Blues
16206941.alt: A pale blue-tinted portrait of a woman with short dark hair gazing directly at the viewer, her face filling the lower left of the frame against a soft gradient background, with elegant script and a track list in the upper right.

16225338.title: Cowboy Bebop (Original Series Soundtrack)
16225338.alt: Anime-style illustration of a dark-haired woman in a yellow outfit and boots crouching against a red background on the left, beside a purple-toned close-up of a spiky-haired man smoking a cigarette on the right, with faint embossed text across the lower portion.

17432302.title: Demon Days
17432302.alt: Four cartoon character portraits in profile — a red-haired figure, a green-haired one in a plaid cap smoking, a green-skinned figure in a naval cap, and a purple-skinned one with a helmet and goggles — arranged in a 2×2 grid of white panels on a black background.

17708911.title: Strong Bad Sings and Other Type Hits
17708911.alt: A muscular, red-masked luchador-style monster with bat wings, a robotic arm holding a microphone, and blue zebra-striped pants stands astride a rocky graveyard hill, backlit by a huge full moon in a starry night sky, rendered in dramatic airbrushed metal-poster style with a blue and teal palette.

19793416.title: Persona 5 Royal
19793416.alt: A red halftone-dotted cover split into angular comic-style panels showing close-up anime character faces in muted gold and black tones, with a stylized white and red logo in the lower right corner.

20741614.title: Mordechai Remixes
20741614.alt: Purely typographic cover: bold white art-deco style lettering angled across a black square framed by a thin orange-to-blue gradient border, with small italic script text at the left.

21123382.title: Street Fighter Alpha 2
21123382.alt: Painted illustration of six Street Fighter-style martial artists posed in a dynamic group against a large blue circle on a white background, rendered in a manga-influenced style with a blue, purple, and orange palette.

21337933.title: Gorillaz (Super Deluxe Edition)
21337933.alt: On a tan cardboard-textured background with a black spine strip, a monochrome comic-style illustration shows four cartoon band members riding in a camouflage-painted dune buggy, with hand-lettered text below and a torn circular "DMC Always Listening" sticker in the top right corner.

22523807.title: Hades: Original Soundtrack
22523807.alt: A dark, shadowy illustration of a horned, laurel-crowned figure seated on a throne beneath a skull-adorned Greek pediment, rendered in near-black tones with red and gold accents, framed by a Greek key border and a white trident-like emblem on the left.

22562576.title: Guardians Of The Galaxy Vol. 2
22562576.alt: A weathered vinyl-style sleeve showing five silhouetted heroes and a small raccoon striding forward out of orange fireballs and teal cosmic haze, with distressed white and red block lettering stacked above them.

22895393.title: Pornography
22895393.alt: A shrink-wrapped picture disc vinyl whose surface bears a blurred, heavily distorted red and magenta image of three ghostly faces against black, with matching smeared imagery extending onto the sleeve.

22988906.title: Homework
22988906.alt: Purely typographic cover: a red, brushstroke-style lowercase logo outlined in cream, centered on a dark background with swirling purple-tinted highlights.

23575493.title: Random Access Memories
23575493.alt: Against a black background, two glossy robot helmets — one silver and one gold — are merged into a single face, split vertically down the middle, with flowing white handwritten script in the upper left corner.

23597402.title: The Blonde & Pink Albums
23597402.alt: Extreme close-up of a face cropped from forehead to upper cheeks, showing dramatic drag-style eye makeup with heavy black shadow, thick lashes, pink and white graphic liner, arched brows, and voluminous platinum-blonde hair framing the pale skin.

23936870.title: Shortbus (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)
23936870.alt: A colorful hand-painted illustration on black shows a nude green Statue of Liberty figure arching acrobatically over a pink-and-purple skyscraper, with a yellow school bus spewing gray exhaust below and bursts of multicolored fireworks filling the sky, framed by bubbly red and white script lettering.

24600890.title: Renaissance
24600890.alt: A woman with long blonde hair in a silver bodysuit and heels sits sidesaddle atop a glowing, translucent chrome-like horse against a solid black background.

24709055.title: Back To Mine
24709055.alt: A pale blue textured background frames a graphic sunset disc banded in red, orange and pink, overlaid with black silhouetted leaves, grasses and seed pods and thin line-drawn mountain peaks below.

25084453.title: Malebox
25084453.alt: A bright yellow album cover with black geometric triangles and a grid pattern framing a black-and-white photograph of a young man with a mustache working at an analog mixing console, with cursive script lettering across the lower left.

25278418.title: Hello Destiny
25278418.alt: A cartoon-style illustration of a snarling retro sci-fi space heroine in a bubble helmet with antennae, wearing a white top and red pants while firing a ray gun at an exploding planet, set against a purple, black and pink swirling starfield.

25285603.title: Friday Night, Saturday Morning / I Can't Stand It (Work In Progress Versions)
25285603.alt: A brown cardboard-style sleeve with a black cut-out illustration of a suited rude boy in sunglasses and porkpie hat down the left side, black-and-white checkerboard banding, and a shrink-wrapped die-cut window revealing the cream and black record label at center.

25379512.title: This Is What We Do
25379512.alt: A woman in a teal top and black leggings stretches out her arm to hold a child's hand as they step across rocky canyon-edge terrain under a hazy sky, in warm muted earth tones.

25383898.title: Rooty
25383898.alt: A photorealistic airbrushed close-up of a white albino gorilla with a squinting, scrunched face, holding a green leafy branch against a bright blue sky with clouds, framed by graffiti-style layered lettering in yellow, cyan and magenta.

25459150.title: BLEACH Original Soundtrack Vinyl Edition
25459150.alt: An orange-haired anime warrior in tattered white robes and bandaged arms grips a large sword, set against a white background with swirling black smoke and flowing cloth, rendered in a detailed manga illustration style.

25768747.title: Music Has The Right To Children
25768747.alt: A grainy, faded vintage photograph of a family group standing at a scenic overlook, their faces blurred out, washed in cool teal and green tones with a rocky overhang framing the top.

25937089.title: Melodrama
25937089.alt: A painterly portrait of a young woman lying on her side amid rumpled bedsheets, rendered in bold blue, violet, and warm gold brushstrokes, her face lit dramatically as she gazes toward the viewer.

26182157.title: Cracker Island
26182157.alt: Four stylized cartoon figures — a robed person in a pointed hood, a lanky blue-haired man, a young woman in a beret and sweater dress, and a burly man in a cap and tank top — stand in a row against a plain background, rendered entirely in shades of pink and magenta.

26829374.title: Wake Up And Smell The Coffee
26829374.alt: A surreal photographic scene of a vast pale beach under a deep blue sky, where a swarm of glossy red spheres tumbles in from the left casting dark round shadows, while a lone figure reclines on a bed beside a lamp at the right.

26978462.title: Guardians Of The Galaxy Vol3 (Awesome Mix Vol3)
26978462.alt: A group of silhouetted figures, including a raccoon and a tree-like creature, stand atop a curved rocky ledge against a vivid purple, pink and orange cloud-filled sky with a large planet and starfield above.

27306252.title: The Pink And Black Album
27306252.alt: A black cover featuring a downward-pointing triangle filled with a magenta-tinted, high-contrast illustration of three figures in gas masks and hooded fetish gear raising their arms, framed by white block lettering repeated along the triangle's edges.

28019751.title: Unreal Unearth
28019751.alt: A close-up photograph of a mouth partially buried in dark soil, teeth bared and clenching the stem of a white daisy, with earthy black and brown tones surrounding the pale skin and lips.

29147968.title: The Rise And Fall Of A Midwest Princess

30246716.title: Never Erased
30246716.alt: A muted, desaturated photograph of two bare-skinned figures embracing, with two zebra finches perched on a shoulder and a hand tangled in scribbled red thread, under thin red capital lettering at the top.

30253094.title: Cowboy Carter
30253094.alt: A woman stands barefoot on a small white platform against a dark charcoal background, wearing long beaded braids and a white pageant-style sash with red trim draped over her nude body, holding up a smoking object in one raised hand.

36594097.title: पर्वत (The Mountain)
36594097.alt: Four illustrated cartoon figures stand atop a steep rocky peak surrounded by vast pastel pink, blue and gold clouds, with Devanagari lettering above and a pink-orange vertical obi strip along the left edge.
